---
title: "Photo Journal"
page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<style>

/* ==========================================================
   PHOTO JOURNAL — PAGE
========================================================== */

body:has(#tahia-photojournal) #quarto-content,
body:has(#tahia-photojournal) #quarto-document-content,
body:has(#tahia-photojournal) main.content {
    max-width: none !important;
}


/* ==========================================================
   FULL-WIDTH GALLERY CONTAINER
========================================================== */

#tahia-photojournal {
    position: relative !important;

    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 8px !important;

    box-sizing: border-box !important;

    background: #ffffff !important;
}


/* ==========================================================
   PHOTO GRID
========================================================== */

#tahia-photo-grid {
    display: grid !important;

    grid-template-columns:
        repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;

    gap: 8px !important;

    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;

    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}


/* ==========================================================
   INDIVIDUAL PHOTO
========================================================== */

#tahia-photo-grid .tahia-photo {
    position: relative !important;

    display: block !important;

    width: 100% !important;

    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3 !important;

    min-width: 0 !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;

    overflow: hidden !important;

    background: #eeeeee !important;

    cursor: pointer !important;
}


/* ==========================================================
   THUMBNAIL IMAGE
========================================================== */

#tahia-photo-grid .tahia-photo > img {
    position: absolute !important;

    top: 0 !important;
    left: 0 !important;

    display: block !important;

    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;

    min-width: 0 !important;
    max-width: none !important;

    min-height: 0 !important;
    max-height: none !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;

    object-fit: cover !important;
    object-position: center !important;

    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;

    box-shadow: none !important;

    transition: transform 0.25s ease !important;
}

#tahia-photo-grid .tahia-photo:hover > img {
    transform: scale(1.02) !important;
}


/* ==========================================================
   PHOTO TITLE
========================================================== */

#tahia-photo-grid .tahia-photo-name {
    position: absolute !important;

    left: 10px !important;
    right: 10px !important;
    bottom: 8px !important;

    z-index: 10 !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;

    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif !important;

    font-size: 15px !important;
    line-height: 1.1 !important;

    font-weight: 500 !important;

    color: #ffffff !important;

    text-shadow:
        0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95),
        0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);

    pointer-events: none !important;
}


/* ==========================================================
   LIGHTBOX
========================================================== */

#tahia-lightbox {
    position: fixed !important;

    inset: 0 !important;

    z-index: 999999 !important;

    display: none !important;

    width: 100vw !important;
    height: 100vh !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 60px 80px 70px !important;

    box-sizing: border-box !important;

    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;

    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98) !important;
}

#tahia-lightbox.tahia-open {
    display: flex !important;
}


/* ==========================================================
   FULL-SIZE IMAGE
========================================================== */

#tahia-lightbox-image {
    position: static !important;

    display: block !important;

    width: auto !important;
    height: auto !important;

    min-width: 0 !important;
    min-height: 0 !important;

    max-width: calc(100vw - 190px) !important;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 145px) !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;

    object-fit: contain !important;

    border: none !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;

    box-shadow: none !important;

    transform: none !important;
}


/* ==========================================================
   LIGHTBOX TITLE
========================================================== */

#tahia-lightbox-title {
    position: fixed !important;

    left: 50% !important;
    bottom: 18px !important;

    transform: translateX(-50%) !important;

    width: auto !important;
    max-width: 80vw !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;

    font-family: "Cormorant Garamond", serif !important;

    font-size: 18px !important;
    line-height: 1.2 !important;

    font-weight: 500 !important;

    color: #333333 !important;

    text-align: center !important;
}


/* ==========================================================
   LIGHTBOX BUTTONS
========================================================== */

#tahia-close,
#tahia-prev,
#tahia-next {
    position: fixed !important;

    z-index: 1000000 !important;

    display: flex !important;

    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;

    width: 44px !important;
    height: 44px !important;

    min-width: 44px !important;
    min-height: 44px !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;

    border: 1px solid #dddddd !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;

    background: #ffffff !important;

    color: #222222 !important;

    font-family: Arial, sans-serif !important;

    line-height: 1 !important;

    cursor: pointer !important;

    box-shadow: none !important;
}


/* Close */

#tahia-close {
    top: 80px !important;
    right: 24px !important;

    font-size: 27px !important;
}


/* Previous / next */

#tahia-prev,
#tahia-next {
    top: 50% !important;

    transform: translateY(-50%) !important;

    font-size: 29px !important;
}

#tahia-prev {
    left: 22px !important;
}

#tahia-next {
    right: 22px !important;
}


/* ==========================================================
   RESPONSIVE — MEDIUM DESKTOP
========================================================== */

@media (max-width: 1300px) {

    #tahia-photo-grid {
        grid-template-columns:
            repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
    }

}


/* ==========================================================
   RESPONSIVE — TABLET
========================================================== */

@media (max-width: 1000px) {

    #tahia-photo-grid {
        grid-template-columns:
            repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
    }

}


@media (max-width: 750px) {

    #tahia-photo-grid {
        grid-template-columns:
            repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
    }

}


/* ==========================================================
   RESPONSIVE — MOBILE
========================================================== */

@media (max-width: 520px) {

    #tahia-photojournal {
        padding: 5px !important;
    }

    #tahia-photo-grid {
        grid-template-columns:
            repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;

        gap: 5px !important;
    }

    #tahia-photo-grid .tahia-photo-name {
        left: 7px !important;
        right: 7px !important;
        bottom: 6px !important;

        font-size: 13px !important;
    }

    #tahia-lightbox {
        padding: 55px 15px 65px !important;
    }

    #tahia-lightbox-image {
        max-width: 94vw !important;
        max-height: 80vh !important;
    }

    #tahia-prev {
        left: 5px !important;
    }

    #tahia-next {
        right: 5px !important;
    }

}


/* ==========================================================
   GALLERY HTML
========================================================== */

</style>

<!-- ==========================================================
     LIGHTBOX
========================================================== -->

<div id="tahia-lightbox">

<button id="tahia-close" type="button" aria-label="Close">&times;</button>

<button id="tahia-prev" type="button" aria-label="Previous">&#8249;</button>

<img id="tahia-lightbox-image" src="" alt="">

<button id="tahia-next" type="button" aria-label="Next">&#8250;</button>

<div id="tahia-lightbox-title"></div>

</div>


<script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    const photos = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll("#tahia-photo-grid .tahia-photo")
    );

    const lightbox =
        document.getElementById("tahia-lightbox");

    const lightboxImage =
        document.getElementById("tahia-lightbox-image");

    const lightboxTitle =
        document.getElementById("tahia-lightbox-title");

    const closeButton =
        document.getElementById("tahia-close");

    const previousButton =
        document.getElementById("tahia-prev");

    const nextButton =
        document.getElementById("tahia-next");

    let currentIndex = 0;


    /* ======================================================
       SHOW PHOTO
    ====================================================== */

    function showPhoto(index) {

        if (index < 0) {
            index = photos.length - 1;
        }

        if (index >= photos.length) {
            index = 0;
        }

        currentIndex = index;

        const photo = photos[currentIndex];

        lightboxImage.src =
            photo.dataset.image;

        lightboxImage.alt =
            photo.dataset.title;

        lightboxTitle.textContent =
            photo.dataset.title;

    }


    /* ======================================================
       OPEN LIGHTBOX
    ====================================================== */

    function openLightbox(index) {

        showPhoto(index);

        lightbox.classList.add("tahia-open");

        document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

    }


    /* ======================================================
       CLOSE LIGHTBOX
    ====================================================== */

    function closeLightbox() {

        lightbox.classList.remove("tahia-open");

        document.body.style.overflow = "";

    }


    /* ======================================================
       CLICK PHOTOS
    ====================================================== */

    photos.forEach(function (photo, index) {

        photo.addEventListener("click", function () {

            openLightbox(index);

        });

    });


    /* ======================================================
       CLOSE
    ====================================================== */

    closeButton.addEventListener("click", function (event) {

        event.stopPropagation();

        closeLightbox();

    });


    /* ======================================================
       PREVIOUS
    ====================================================== */

    previousButton.addEventListener("click", function (event) {

        event.stopPropagation();

        showPhoto(currentIndex - 1);

    });


    /* ======================================================
       NEXT
    ====================================================== */

    nextButton.addEventListener("click", function (event) {

        event.stopPropagation();

        showPhoto(currentIndex + 1);

    });


    /* ======================================================
       CLICK BACKGROUND TO CLOSE
    ====================================================== */

    lightbox.addEventListener("click", function (event) {

        if (event.target === lightbox) {

            closeLightbox();

        }

    });


    /* ======================================================
       KEYBOARD
    ====================================================== */

    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {

        if (!lightbox.classList.contains("tahia-open")) {
            return;
        }

        if (event.key === "Escape") {

            closeLightbox();

        }

        if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {

            showPhoto(currentIndex - 1);

        }

        if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {

            showPhoto(currentIndex + 1);

        }

    });

});

</script>
```
